name: Qasia
source:
As the owner of the brothel at the desert outpost, she takes care of all the local traveler's needs. From her appearance and tongue you'd says she's from a distant human kingdom. A mysterious aura surrounds her, as if she knows far more than she reveals.

[In game description]
